description: A 100 ohm load from 5 V into the collector, with the base fed through 1 kilohm from 5 V. The base current is far more than the load needs, so the transistor saturates.
derivation: Base current (5 - 0.7) / 1002 = 4.3 mA times gain 100 would be 0.43 A, above the 48 mA the load allows, so the part saturates: collector current (5 - 0.2) / (100 + 0.01) = 0.047995 A and the collector sits at 0.2 + 0.01 x i = 0.20048 V.
